kills.property: Deposits must accumulate: after any two admissible deposits by the same actor, c.balances(actor) equals the sum of the t
kills.change_summary: Replace the additive balance update with an assignment so the balance is overwritten by the deposit amount instead of accumulating.

kills.property: Deposits accumulate: after two deposits of amounts v1 and v2, the balance equals v1+v2.
kills.change_summary: Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender]=msg.value;`, so the deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.

kills.property: After a Deposit of amount v > MinDeposit, the caller's recorded balance increases by exactly v (not by MinDeposit).
kills.change_summary: Credit only `MinDeposit` instead of `msg.value`, so balances increase by a different amount than in P.

kills.property: A deposit with value equal to MinDeposit must not change the depositor's recorded balance in C.
kills.change_summary: Change the guard from `msg.value > MinDeposit` to `msg.value >= MinDeposit`, so deposits equal to MinDeposit now update balances.

kills.property: After a Deposit of v ether (v > 1), the caller's recorded balance must equal v.
kills.change_summary: Delete the balance update statement `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` so deposits never change balances.

kills.property: After a Deposit of more than MinDeposit, the transaction origin's balance in c must remain zero (Deposit credits only ms
kills.change_summary: Credit the deposit to `tx.origin` instead of `msg.sender`, so balances change at a different key than in P.
